// diagnostic

E1345

CLI command member `{name}` has no callable shape

What

CLI command member `{name}` has no callable shape

Why

A CLI callable member needs a same-module target when bound, at most one first read-only program-struct parameter, and scalar remaining parameters.

Fix

Bind a visible scalar-parameter function, or use a method on the program struct

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1345: tests/ui/cli_program_member_shape.stderr.

Error [E1345]: CLI command member `bad` has no callable shape
  --> tests/ui/cli_program_member_shape.jet:3:11
    |
  3 |     bad = 1
    |           ^
 Why: the binding target must be a function declared in the same program module
 Fix: bind a visible function with scalar parameters and, at most, one first read-only parameter of the program-struct type
